releases.title: 版本更新
content: 新增：粘贴纯文本时自动识别 Markdown 语法并渲染为对应格式，`# 标题`、`- 列表`、`**加粗**`、表格与代码块等源码粘贴后直接呈现排版效果
优化：粘贴内容仅在确实包含 Markdown 语法时才按格式渲染，配置文件、终端输出等普通文本仍按纯文本插入，不会把 `[Unit]`、`a*b*c` 误解析成排版
优化：粘贴前自动还原外部文本中多余的转义符（如 `\#` → `#`），过度转义的 Markdown 源码同样能被正确识别与渲染
优化：按住 Shift 粘贴仍强制以纯文本插入；标题、表格单元格、代码块等区域保持原有粘贴保护逻辑不变
修复：文档 Agent 工具参数被截断或校验失败时，会明确提示该次调用未执行，并引导重新提交更小的修改，避免续写半截参数导致脱轨
修复：修复反引号被转义时被误判为行内代码的问题，避免多余转义符被写进文档
新增：图片支持 width / height 尺寸标注，用 HTML 写的 `` 现在能按标注尺寸显示，并在保存后原样保留，不再被静默丢弃
优化：favicon、徽章这类行内小图标自动校准尺寸，`![](favicon.ico)` 这种不带尺寸的写法也会缩到与文字协调（此前会按原始尺寸 48×48 显示，把行高撑开）；独占一行的插图不受影响
优化：行内图标与文字垂直居中对齐，并在图标与后续文字之间保留约 4px 间隙，不再贴着字显示
修复：修复以 `/` 开头的资源地址被错误解析到磁盘分区根目录的问题（如 `/fav_error.png` 曾被解析成 `C:\fav_error.png`），现在按文档所在目录解析，图片可正常显示
修复：修复从侧栏文件树或最近记录打开的文档，其同级图片、附件被判定为无权访问而无法显示的问题
优化：图片读取失败时区分「文件不存在」「格式不支持」与「无权访问」并给出具体路径，不再把图片缺失提示成权限问题，方便快速定位
contentEn: Pasting plain text auto-detects Markdown syntax and renders it: headings, lists, bold text, tables, and code blocks paste as formatted content.
Pasting renders only when Markdown syntax is actually present; config files and terminal output stay plain text, and bracket or asterisk text is not misparsed.
Extra escape characters in external text are restored before pasting, so over-escaped Markdown is recognized and rendered correctly.
Shift paste still forces plain text; headings, table cells, and code blocks keep their existing paste protections.
When Document Agent tool arguments are truncated or fail validation, the app states that the call did not run and asks for a smaller retry, avoiding truncated-argument runaway.
Fixed escaped backticks being misdetected as inline code, which wrote extra escape characters into documents.
Images support width and height attributes: an img tag with explicit dimensions displays at that size and is preserved on save.

Small inline icons such as favicons and badges are auto-sized; an image without dimensions scales to match text instead of using its original 48 by 48 size and stretching the line; standalone images are unaffected.
Inline icons align vertically centered with text with about 4px spacing.
Fixed resource paths starting with a slash being resolved to the disk root; they now resolve relative to the document folder.
Fixed images and attachments next to documents opened from the file tree or recent list being denied access.
Image read failures now distinguish missing files, unsupported formats, and denied access with the specific path, instead of reporting everything as a permission problem.

linux.requirements: 主流 64 位 Linux 发行版
